notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this tower: a row in the FFLA index (name, county, coordinates, type, status). Searches for its history returned only the Herkimer Moose River Mountain tower, which is a separate, removed site. Two Facebook group posts titled 'Moose River fire tower story' appear to mention a tower near Half Moon Lake in Watson, Lewis County, but the pages could not be read beyond their titles, so they are not used. Rock Mountain (Lewis Co.) in the index is at 43.81416 -75.23833, a different site. A local source (Lewis County historian or NYS DEC) is needed before a fuller history is published. The record's kind 'tower' is consistent with the index's windmill tower type; no correction proposed.
